title: L — Exp 8: LCD1602 4-bit on Port B
summary: HD44780 LCD1602 driven in 4-bit mode (RS=PB0, RW=PB1 tied to GND, E=PB2, D4–D7=PB4–PB7) with SysTick COUNTFLAG delays at 50 MHz. Shows a greeting, a custom CGRAM heart, and a counter.
expected: LCD line 1 shows "Hello, TM4C123!"; line 2 shows "LCD1602 ♥ n=X" with X counting every 200 ms
